Track the three dipped corners back to the open sheet. Take the sheet as the square from −1 to 1.

The zigzag fold makes 8 panels with 7 folds, and the folds alternate between the two sides of the folded stack.

- A V-notch on one side opens into a diamond at each fold on that side. A notch at a free edge becomes a half-notch.
- With 8 panels (even), both free edges P and Q end up on the same side as P. P's side has the **upper** notch, so P, Q and the 3 folds on that side get upper notches. The other 4 folds get **lower** diamonds.
